text: Agency report AGY-001. Intercepts indicate Vikram Rana coordinates payments through Deepak Shetty. A handset registered to +91-9966332211 was active near the Kurla West locker facility on the night of the handover. Vehicle DL-01-AB-4402 was used as the courier car.

Agency report AGY-002. Ravi Moti acted as the financial courier, moving Rs 12 lakh in cash between Nehru Nagar and Paharganj. Contact number +91-8720011455 was used to confirm each drop with Salim Qureshi.
